steps.content: A gang of thirty or so people is besieging an old converted warehouse, on top of which hangs a broken upside-down cross, overlooking this unprecedentedly bloody battle.
This is SALVA. In the middle of the battlefield stands the hospital, and your target is the basement underneath.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Seem like we got here too late. Are those gangsters attacking the hospital your men?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: No, they're fighters from the Gonzales family. Looks like they heard the news too and have come to rob the place.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: But how are they so powerful. Could it be that...?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: These gangsters look odd. They've been severely infested by Mania now.

steps.speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
steps.content: Oh, hey—it's Ted! Our little Teddie is here—What a pity. You came here too late. Hehehe.

steps.speaker: Gonzales Gangsters
steps.content: Kill him! Kill him! Kill him! SALVA is ours! It's ours!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, dear. You haven't even taken down SALVA yet, and you're already fighting amongst yourselves. You gangsters will always be crappy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, stand behind me. Let me show you how to teach them a lesson!
